findings.section: Description of Capital Stock — Common Stock — Dividend Rights
findings.shortExcerpt: not declared or paid any cash dividends on our common stock since April 2005
findings.conclusion: The January 2025 filing retrospectively states absence of common-stock cash dividends since April 2005, covering the complete 2020–2024 calendar window.
findings.limitation: Cash-dividend absence only; does not prove absence of stock splits, spin-offs or all corporate actions.

sources.section: Note 14 Equity Awards — Valuation Assumptions — Expected dividend yield
sources.shortExcerpt: as we have not and do not currently intend to declare dividends

findings.conclusion: The 2021 annual filing explicitly excludes prior cash dividends. The 2024 annual filing includes retrospective non-declaration language, strengthening coverage through the end of 2024.
findings.limitation: The later wording occurs in a valuation-assumption note and is less explicit than the Adobe historical statement. Retain corroborated status; no all-corporate-actions verification flag is changed.

sources.section: Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows and Note 12 stock-based compensation
sources.summary: Cash-flow financing rows for 2022–2024 do not separately identify dividends; zero expected yield is prospective. Fiscal 2024 ends December 28, not December 31.

findings.conclusion: Current policy and absence of a separately labelled cash-flow row are insufficient to independently establish complete historical absence for every target date.
findings.limitation: No false closure; complete retrospective issuer declaration or reconciled historical statements remain required.
